description: Adds one or more food entries, each with its numbers PER SERVING and the number of servings. perServing takes the macros and any label nutrient (sodiumMg, potassiumMg and the rest); a nutrient left out counts as unknown, not zero. A glass of plain water is an entry named "Water" with kcal and macros 0 and waterMl. Each entry is its own change, with Undo. When the person asks to note a food without numbers ("just note it"), leave perServing out: it shows as numbers not added yet, until edit_food gives it perServing. planned: true puts a meal on a day ahead (or later today) without counting it in any total until it is eaten (edit_food planned: false).

perServing.description: For ONE serving, as the label or a reliable source states it.

servingLabel.description: What one serving is: "1 cup", "100 g", "1 bar".
